venture.headline: Sovereign AI Infrastructure Funds Allocate $4.8B for Domestic Datacenter Clusters
venture.summary: National development banks in Japan and South Korea launched a combined credit facility to back high-efficiency liquid-cooled data facilities. The capital package mandates open access provisions for academic institutions and domestic startups. First facility groundbreaking is slated for Q2 2027.

research.headline: Linear-Time Associative Memories Match Transformer Quality on 100B Benchmarks
research.summary: A multi-institution collaboration introduced a gated recurrent associative memory layer operating strictly in linear time and constant state memory. Empirical evaluations across language understanding and code generation match Llama-3 class dense attention models.

titans.headline: Cloud Giants Form Geothermal Energy Syndicate for Dedicated Baseload Power
titans.summary: Deep drilling geothermal initiatives secured binding commitments from top cloud providers to fund five enhanced geothermal systems near high-density server nodes. The strategy provides round-the-clock zero-emission wattage independent of battery storage cycles.

regulatory.headline: EU AI Office Publishes First Compliance Guidelines for Synthetic Training Data Audits
regulatory.summary: The European Union released preliminary technical guidelines specifying statistical randomness and non-memorization criteria for models trained on synthetic corpuses. Non-compliant enterprises risk phased operational bans.
